children: Canadian grocery giant Loblaw has stuck a deal to become what it says is the first retailer in the country to make its product catalogue available on Meta's AI-powered personal agent Muse. It is part of the company's recent push to introduce AI into customers' shopping experience. Now Canadians will be able to go from store selection to checkout at participating Loblaw banners using Muse, which the Canadian company said will help shoppers find what they need, shop with ease and get more done through agentic AI. (robb.stewart@wsj.com)
